DECLARATIONOFEASEMENT FORCOMMONHEATINGPLANT a New York Corporation,with its principal place of businessat 993 Morris Park Avenue,Bronx, New York (hereinafter referred to as the "Declarant") WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, the Declarant owns a certain building and parcel of land hereinafter referred to as "Parcel 1" known as 295 East 162nd Street, Bronx, New York， situate, lying and being in the State of New York, County of Bronx (see Schedule A attached）also known as Section 9,Block 2422,Lot 50;and WHEREAS, the Declarant is also the Owner of a certain building and  a    s 1m    1   1 Street， Bronx, New York, situate, lying and being in the State of New York, County of Bronx (see Schedule A attached）also known as Section 9, Block 2422，Lot 48. WHEREAS, a Heating System which supplies heat to Parcel 1 and Parcel 2 is located within Parcel 1; and WHEREAS,the Declarant desires to create an easement in favor of Parcel 2 hot water from the heating system contained in Parcel 1, which easement reflects the present actual practice of the Declarant as the Owner of the Parcels. FIRsT: The Declarant， as the Owner of Parcel l，for itself and its successors and assigns, hereby covenants and agrees that, for so long as this Agreement is in full force and effect,it shall furnish and will use located on Parcel 2. Hot water shall be furnished on a year round basis and heat will be furnished as required by the appropriate municipal provide heat and hot water provided that Owner uses due diligence to have the heating system repaired and restored to use. SECoND: The Declarant, also Owner of Parcel 2 and for its respective successors and assigns, each agrees to share equally the cost of the fuel used in the operation of the heating system as well as share equally the -1-

cost of repair, replacement and maintenance of same, including service contracts, as located within Parcel 1, if necessary. Should the ownership of the Parcels not be identical， all bills for fuel oil,repairs, services and replacement costs shall be delivered to the Owner of Parcel 2 for their inspection, prior to the payment of the amount thereof. THIRD: The Owner of Parcel 2 shall not unreasonably withhold consent to and payment for any repairs, maintenance or replacement of the heating system as may be made by the Owner of Parcel 1. FouRTH:IntheeventofthefailureoftheOwnerofParcel1to fulfill the obligations hereunder,the Owner of Parcel 2 may obtain a court order against the Owner of Parcel 1 requiring said Owner to fulfill the obligations hereunder. FIFTH: In the event a separate heating system is installed in Parcel 2which system supplies heat and hot water toParcel 2 and said system operates independently of the system as presently constituted within Parcel 1 (and which is the subject of this Agreement)， this Agreement shall be SIxTH: The covenants contained within this Agreement shall inure to and assigns and shall run with the land.
